_quoi: CE QUE LES ROUTES D'ÉVALUATION SERVENT, et que le catalogue ignorait. Ces phrases sont COMPOSÉES par le serveur au moment de répondre — elles n'existent dans aucun fichier HTML, et ni la passe navigateur ni la passe de routes GET ne pouvait les voir. Les sondes de SONDES_EVALUATION les font entrer : 97 entrées, 1 929 mots qu'un lecteur anglophone lisait en français dès qu'il remplissait un questionnaire.

texte.AI #-# est un PROFIL d'AI #-#, et il ne: AI #-# is a PROFILE of AI #-#, and it is no more certifiable than its parent. These # actions are “suggested” — the document says so itself, and it claims to be neither exhaustive nor suitable for every system. They are therefore not an enforceable checklist: they say what a third party will expect to find, and what you will need to be able to justify when they do not find it.
texte.HORS CHAMP. Vous n'êtes ni un organisme: OUT OF SCOPE. You are neither a public-sector body holding protected data, nor a re-user, nor a data intermediation services provider, nor a recognised data altruism organisation. Regulation (EU) #/# therefore places no obligation on you. This is true of the vast majority of companies, and saying so is better than offering you work with no purpose.
texte.Le Top # OWASP n'est pas un référentiel: The OWASP Top # is not a compliance framework: you do not conform to it, you use it so that nothing obvious is forgotten. It carries a year, and this one is # — the previous one ignored system prompt leakage, vector databases and unbounded consumption.
texte.Ces montants sont des PLAFONDS, pas des: These amounts are CAPS, not forecasts. Article #(#) requires the nature, gravity and duration of the infringement, the operator's record and its size to be taken into account. The penalty regime itself is set by each Member State.
The system is not declared generative. The AI #-# profile does not apply, and the framework's rate remains that of the core. This is not an exemption: it is a qualification, and it is revisited the day a language model enters the chain.
texte.Le cadre NIST AI RMF ne se certifie pas: The NIST AI RMF framework is not certifiable: no body accredits, no auditor is licensed, no certificate exists. “NIST AI RMF compliant” means nothing. This profile says where you stand in YOUR use of the framework, and nothing else.
